steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: These chunks help you organize a real response. Choose the one that matches your meaning, say it from memory, and replace the topic details with your own.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.
